claims.object_text: Intellectual Disability (ID) with comorbid Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) and epilepsy in children
claims.quote: SYNGAP1 (Synaptic Ras-GTPase-activating protein) has been shown to cause Intellectual Disability (ID) with comorbid Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) and epilepsy in children.

claims.object_text: negative regulator of Ras, Rap and of AMPA receptor trafficking to the postsynaptic membrane; regulates synaptic plasticity and neuronal homeostasis
claims.quote: SYNGAP1 is a negative regulator of Ras, Rap and of AMPA receptor trafficking to the postsynaptic membrane, thereby regulating not only synaptic plasticity, but also neuronal homeostasis.

claims.object_text: potential target during critical period of development when the brain is more susceptible to therapeutic intervention
claims.quote: suggests a potential target during critical period of development when the brain is more susceptible to therapeutic intervention.
